description: Economic indicators for the US, euro area, UK and Japan from official sources (statistics offices, central banks, OECD, FRED): inflation, growth, labour market, financial conditions, money and credit, housing, public finances, currencies, expectations surveys. Latest print with its period, change, source, optional history. Without keys or terms it returns the headline readings; catalog: true lists every key.

all.description: Every indicator, not only the headline ones (default false).

catalog.description: Only list the available indicator keys per region.

regions.description: US, EA (euro area), UK, JP. Omit for all four.

since.description: History start YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 5 years ago.

terms.description: Whole-word match on indicator name or group, e.g. ["inflation"], ["unemployment"], ["housing"].

name: get_economic_indicators
title: Get economic indicators
